# Source: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max: # Adapted for wisp-design: schema condensed to 6 columns; web stacks only.

column3: serif-display + sans-meta
column4: hairline rules
column5: archival ivory ground.

column3: prompt
column4: css_template
column5: checklist

column3: Primary CTA — small-caps sans, ink underline
column4: padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ma-ink); font-family: var(--ma-sans); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ma-ink); padding-bottom: 4px;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ tracking 0.12em ☐ visible focus ring offset ☐ 44x44 effective touch via padding

column3: Text-only — serif italic with chevron
column4: padding: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ma-ink); font-family: var(--ma-serif); font-style: italic; font-size: 1rem; border: none;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ trailing chevron via ::after ☐ visible focus ring

column3: Page ground — archival ivory, never pure white
column4: background: var(--ma-ivory); color: var(--ma-ink);
column5: ☐ ground not #fff ☐ AA contrast body ☐ warm archival undertone

column3: Display headline — serif, restrained, flush-left
column4: font-family: var(--ma-serif); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--ma-ink); text-align: left;
column5: ☐ flush-left ☐ weight 400 (institutional restraint) ☐ AA contrast ☐ serif loaded

column3: Metadata row — sans uppercase, hairline rules above and below
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12ch 1fr; gap: 24px; padding-block: 16px; border-block: 1px solid var(--ma-rule); font-family: var(--ma-sans); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--ma-ink-muted);
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ tracking 0.08em ☐ definition-list pattern (<dl>/<dt>/<dd> semantically)

column3: Body prose — serif, oldstyle nums, generous leading
column4: font-family: var(--ma-serif-text); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.65; max-width: 62ch; font-variant-numeric: oldstyle-nums; color: var(--ma-ink);
column5: ☐ max 62ch ☐ line-height 1.6-1.7 ☐ oldstyle nums ☐ AA contrast

column3: Caption — sans uppercase, small, archival metadata
column4: margin-top: 12px; font-family: var(--ma-sans); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--ma-ink-muted);
column5: ☐ semantic <figcaption> ☐ tracking 0.08em ☐ AA contrast

column3: Top nav — serif wordmark, sans uppercase links, hairline rule
column4: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding: 24px 48px; background: var(--ma-ivory); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ma-rule); font-family: var(--ma-sans);
column5: ☐ semantic <nav> ☐ baseline alignment ☐ skip-link ☐ uppercase links

column3: Catalogue card — no chrome, hairline top rule, serif title
column4: padding: 24px 0; background: transparent; border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--ma-rule); border-radius: 0;
column5: ☐ no shadow ☐ no rounded corners ☐ hairline only ☐ serif title

column3: Text input — bottom-rule only, serif body
column4: padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ma-ink); font-family: var(--ma-serif-text); font-size: 1rem; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ma-rule); border-radius: 0;
column5: ☐ font-size ≥16px iOS via rem ☐ focus shifts border-bottom-color ☐ visible label above ☐ AA contrast

column3: Catalogue table — hairline rules, oldstyle nums, serif
column4: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--ma-serif-text); font-variant-numeric: oldstyle-nums; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ma-ink);
column5: ☐ tabular-nums alternative if needed for align ☐ hairline rules ☐ AA contrast

column3: Section divider — hairline rule, generous block-margin
column4: height: 1px; background: var(--ma-rule); margin-block: 80px;
column5: ☐ semantic <hr> ☐ aria-hidden if decorative ☐ generous block margin

column3: Catalogue badge — sans uppercase, hairline border
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ma-ink); border: 1px solid var(--ma-ink); border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--ma-sans); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
column5: ☐ no pill ☐ AA contrast on border + text ☐ semantic colour + text

column3: Hero — flush-left, serif headline, archival metadata row
column4: padding-block: 120px 80px; text-align: left;
column5: ☐ flush-left ☐ no centred hero ☐ archival metadata above headline (date, collection)

column3: Modal — ivory card, hairline border, no soft shadow
column4: padding: 48px; background: var(--ma-ivory); border: 1px solid var(--ma-rule); border-radius: 0; max-width: 600px;
column5: ☐ focus-trap ☐ ESC closes ☐ no soft shadow ☐ no rounded corners

column3: Footer — multi-column, hairline top, sans metadata
column4: padding-block: 80px 48px; background: var(--ma-ivory); border-top: 1px solid var(--ma-rule); font-family: var(--ma-sans);
column5: ☐ semantic <footer> ☐ multi-column responsive ☐ AA contrast

column3: Archival list — definition-list pattern, hairline rules between
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column;
column5: ☐ semantic <dl>/<dt>/<dd> ☐ hairline rules between entries ☐ AA contrast

column3: Breadcrumb — sans uppercase, slash separator
column4: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--ma-sans); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--ma-ink-muted);
column5: ☐ aria-label='Breadcrumb' ☐ aria-current='page' on last ☐ tracking 0.08em

column3: Section vertical rhythm — generous, institutional
column4: padding-block: clamp(96px, 14vh, 180px);
column5: ☐ section padding ≥96px ☐ clamp for fluid scaling

column3: Focus ring — ink outline offset
column4: outline: 2px solid var(--ma-ink); outline-offset: 3px;
column5: ☐ visible on all interactive ☐ AA contrast ☐ generous offset (3px) for archival breathing
